Matthew Greene works on: interests in the development of mobile sensing (phones, wearables), intervention and AI technology capable of accurately assessing and managing mental illness (e.g., anxiety, depression, schizophrenia) at population-scale. Subject: Exploring Postdoc Opportunities in Mobile Sensing and Mental Health

Dear Dr. Greene,

I hope this email finds you well. As I've been following your work on the development of mobile sensing technologies and intervention systems for mental health, I've become increasingly impressed by the potential of your research to positively impact individuals and populations. My own background in building large-scale, deployable sensing systems for smart environments and developing foundation machine learning models for human activity recognition and health applications has led me to believe that our work is more closely aligned than I initially thought.

The intersection of mobile sensing and mental health is a fascinating area, and I'm excited to explore potential postdoc opportunities in your lab. My research experience has equipped me with a strong foundation in machine learning, data analysis, and system design, which I believe would be a valuable asset to your team. I'm particularly drawn to your work on developing AI technology capable of accurately assessing and managing mental illness, such as anxiety, depression, and schizophrenia, at population-scale. The potential for mobile sensing to provide real-time, personalized interventions is a puzzle I'm eager to help solve.

As I reflect on my own research, I'm reminded of the importance of creating a puzzle that is both challenging and solvable. My experience in building large-scale sensing systems has taught me the value of understanding the rhythm of human behavior and developing systems that can adapt to this rhythm. I'm excited to explore how my skills can contribute to the development of mobile sensing technologies that can help address the puzzle of mental health.

In your lab, I envision working on projects that involve developing AI-powered systems that can detect early warning signs of mental illness, such as changes in behavior or physiological rhythms, and provide personalized interventions to help individuals manage their condition. This is a puzzle that requires a deep understanding of the fish-like behavior of individuals with mental illness, as well as the ability to develop systems that can navigate the complexities of human behavior.

As I look to the dawn of a new era in mental health research, I'm excited about the prospect of joining your team and contributing to the development of innovative solutions that can help address the puzzle of mental illness. I believe that my skills and experience make me a strong fit for a postdoc position in your lab, and I'm eager to discuss this opportunity further.

In the words of the great puzzle master, "The puzzle is not solved until the dawn." I'm excited to join your team and help solve the puzzle of mental health, one piece at a time.

Thank you for considering my inquiry. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss this further and explore how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
